# Energy-accumulator cases shared by linux/power/flightrec/src/acc.rs and
# linux/power/battery/report/y700_battery/acc_ref.py. Generated by make-fixtures.py (here) - do not edit by hand.
#   case NAME / note TEXT / end
#   boot B                      a fresh count for boot B
#   begin T DPMS                the recorder's start: begin(DPMS), an edge at T
#   l T MW OK STATUS DPMS BL    a data line: t s, bat mW as logged, voltage+current read (1/0), battery status read
#                               on a zero current ('-' none, '_' = space), dpms, backlight level ('-' none)
#   restart B T DPMS            the recorder restarts in boot B: resume from the energy line if B matches, else zero
#   expect LINE                 the energy line now
#   edge LINE                   the next edge line written

case pw-debounce

case restart-same-boot
note synthetic. the recorder restarts within the boot: the count goes on from the file, the open run comes back in the line's dpms bucket and the step over the restart is integrated; pw votes start again
boot aaaa1111
begin 10.0 On
edge v1 t=10.0 dpms=On pw=unk
l 10.0 +500 1 - On 200
l 20.0 +500 1 - On 200
l 30.0 -0 1 Discharging Off -
edge v1 t=30.0 dpms=Off pw=unk
restart aaaa1111 45.0 Off
edge v1 t=45.0 dpms=Off pw=unk
l 50.0 +300 1 - Off -
expect v1 boot=aaaa1111 t=0000000050000 n=0000000000004 ton=0000000010000 toff=0000000030000 don=0000000005000 doff=0000000012000 dton=0000000010000 dtoff=0000000030000 chg=0000000000000 tchg=0000000000000 tz=0000000000000 tzero=0000000000000 gap=0000000000000 bl=0000002000000 lb=+000000000300 lbt=0000000050000 dpms=Off pw=unk
end
